text:
marta: Heads-up — prepping release notes for the upcoming canary (EU midnight window). Draft below; need ops + legal signoff before I queue the internal blast.

marta: Draft release note snippet: "Redwood API: improved KV cache warmup reducing cold-start token latency by ~30%. Model v2.1.3 pinned for canary; automatic fallback to v2.0.9 under overload. Minor SDK auth header behind feature flag (opt-in)."

devansh: Dropping a more detailed bullet list for the RN:
- kv-cache: warmer strategy + metrics exposed
- model: v2.1.3 (pin), fallback v2.0.9
- perf: ~30% cold-start token latency improvement in p95
- sdk: opt-in auth header change (no immediate rollout)

kai: Quick ops questions: can we make rollback criteria: error rate > 1.5% for 5m OR p95 latency > 1500ms for 3m? Also want to run canary at 5% traffic, ramp to 20% at +10m if healthy.

lia: Legal quick note — add a sentence about EU data residency for private customers. I can sign off after that's added.

devansh: Command we'll run: 
```
/deploy canary eu-1 --pin model:v2.1.3 --tag rn-2026-04-02 --traffic 5%
```
(then ramp command if metrics OK). I'll wire alerts to canary-errors@pager and infra-channel.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled canary rn-2026-04-02 for eu-1 at 2026-04-02T00:30:00Z; cue registered by marta. Reply with "ACK" to confirm standby.

devansh: ACK — infra monitoring in place, alerts configured. We'll watch metrics dashboards and logs.

kai: SGTM. I'll be on-call for the ramp. I'll also add a quick SDK note under "breaking changes (opt-in)" so PMs and SDK leads see it.

marta: Added legal line: "Private European customers: data processed in EU regions and retained per configured residency settings." Lia, please confirm if wording is OK.

lia: :thumbsup: wording looks good, legal greenlight.

marta: Need a 1-line internal blurb to post in #eng-releases ~30m before window (ops + eng). Can someone craft a concise message?

devansh: One-liner suggestion: "Canary deploy v2.1.3 (rn-2026-04-02): 5% traffic in EU -> ramp to 20% if healthy. Oncall: infra/devansh, eng/kai. Rollback if >1.5% errors or p95 >1500ms."

kai: I'll stand by and run the ramp at +10m if nothing anomalous. I'll also annotate the canary with the canary checklist tag.

marta: Perfect — I'll update the release-notes doc, queue the internal announce, and hit the deploy-bot 30m prior. Tagging @eng-oncall and @ops in the blast.

devansh: Note for the ops playbook: include steps to force-fallback to v2.0.9 and how to cut traffic instantly:
```
/deploy set-traffic eu-1 0% --target model:v2.0.9
```

marta: Thanks all. Final check: everyone OK with language in RN and the internal blurb? Reply quick.

kai: OK from eng side.

devansh: OK from infra.

lia: Legal signed.

marta: Great — I'll schedule the pre-flight ping. :rocket:
